veranderings.voor: van die metaalrand van die wiel gelig
veranderings.na: van die wiel se metaalrand af gelig
veranderings.rede: Two stacked 'van' phrases read clumsily; the possessive with the closing 'af' is the natural Afrikaans construction and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: het nog in die rubber vasgesteek
veranderings.na: het nog in die rubber gesteek
veranderings.rede: 'Vassteek' means to pin something fast or to stop short; for a thorn lodged in rubber Afrikaans says 'in die rubber gesteek'.

veranderings.voor: met die grondpad na die dam gery
veranderings.na: met die grondpad langs na die dam gery
veranderings.rede: Travelling along a road is idiomatically 'met die pad langs'; 'met die grondpad' alone reads as if the road were the vehicle.
